Ben learned a lot about history. There are always many people at the old town. Last Sunday, Ben and Mia went to the ticket office. She wrote his number on a paper pad.
Mia's birthday is in March. Ben hopes to visit Sydney one day. Mia is interested in swimming. In fact, the gift left him speechless.
Ben is going to travel to Sydney in March. Ben and Mia had great fun there. The weather was sunny that day. Best of all, the rescue puppy was born with a minor leg deformity.
Ben wrote about the day in the diary. Ben bought a sweater at the shop yesterday. They took many photos at the old town.
